about_the_game:
Desktop Fishes transforms your computer desktop into a playful, interactive aquarium filled with adorable, retro pixel-art fishes! 🐠✨

Discover and collect a huge variety of fishes, breed them and create unique new species, there are over 10,000 possible genetic combinations! Each baby fish inherits cool traits from it's parents, giving you endless new surprises to explore!

Your aquarium is alive and swimming directly over your desktop apps, letting you casually interact while working, browsing, or gaming. Feed your fishes, gently play with them, or simply move your mouse and watch them react playfully—they love attention and will respond to your every click and hover!

Features:

🐟 Breed & Discover: Combine different fishes to uncover brand-new species and unexpected genetic traits. Every new fish is a fun surprise waiting to be discovered!

🖥️ Interactive Overlay: Your fishes seamlessly swim over your desktop applications or stay in the background, making your workspace a bit more cheerful without getting in your way.

🖱️ Playful Interaction: Feed your fish and interact with them directly using your mouse—they'll eagerly swim towards your cursor, respond to your actions, and become your playful desktop companions.

🌊 Idle-Friendly Fun: Perfectly designed for casual play, Desktop Fishes lets you enjoy a relaxing aquarium experience at your own pace. Your fishes will thrive even when you're busy doing other things, making your desktop livelier and more delightful every day.

Dive into the fun, explore endless fishy combinations, and bring your desktop to life with your own vibrant, swimming friends!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11
  • Sound Card: Not needed

short_description: A casual idle aquarium game that sits on your desktop—breed, discover, and collect thousands of unique fish combinations right on your screen while you work or play!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
